note: The only HTTP 200 capture in the 365-day window is the robots.txt URL. The archived body is a frameset forwarding page to neldamartinez.nationbuilder.com. The earlier search note treated it as only a robots file, but the content is the campaign site page. An unfiltered CDX query failed once (curl rc 35) and was not repeated; the status-200 filtered query worked. Doubt: the capture URL is robots.txt, not the site root.

page_evidence: Beth Van Duyne For Mayor of Irving ... Issues ... 'If elected Mayor, I would immediately request an account of all monies spent' (Home, About Beth, The Issues, Volunteer, Contribute, Contact)
note: CDX for 2010-06-18 to 2011-06-18 returned 30 HTTP 200 captures (all URLs on the domain, including images and scripts). Pages read: /issues (2011-04-13) shows the campaign. The 2013 captures show the 2011 victory message and the Dallas Morning News endorsement for the May 14 ballot, so the site belongs to this election.

The domain bethforirving.com has 50 or more HTTP 200 captures in the 365 days to 2014-05-10 (first 20130512121142), but the page content is only from the 2011 election: the 2013-05-12 root shows the 2011 victory message ('On Saturday, the voters of Irving chose...'), and 2013-07-25 pages show the 2011 Gears race and 2011 early voting dates. The only after-window root capture (20140517014822) is a re-election pitch ('I am asking for your vote and your support so we can continue') with no election date and with references to 2013. It may belong to a later election, not this one. Doubt: no Irving mayoral election is known on 2014-05-10, so the election date in the input may be wrong. Re-check if the date is corrected. No other qualifying domain was found.
